pastel.name: Pastel Americana
pastel.refs: reference 289a (giant plush whale, swan, snail, cat, giraffe), db40 (moon giraffe, star seedlings, rainbow laundry), grid 1/3/5/7/9
pastel.style: Shot on 35mm Kodachrome film in a 1950s American small town: candy-pastel clapboard houses (baby pink, powder blue, mint, butter yellow), white picket fences, trimmed emerald lawns, by day a clear cornflower-blue sky with a few soft cotton clouds. Symmetrical, centred, storybook-tidy framing like a Wes Anderson film. Soft even light (flat soft sunshine by day; at dusk or night a periwinkle-to-navy sky with warm glowing windows, the time of day the shot names always wins), gentle film grain, slight halation on highlights, creamy pastel colours with rich green grass. Everyone wears 1950s clothes. Every impossible thing is soft, real and tactile: fluffy fur, felt, cotton, glass, porcelain, never CGI-glossy.
pastel.music: dreamy 1950s doo-wop ballad, instrumental, soft vibraphone melody, warm upright bass, brushed snare, celesta sparkles, vintage vinyl warmth, slow 6/8 sway, 72 bpm

a young woman with soft blonde waves, a pink gingham swing dress with a white Peter Pan collar and a cream cardigan
a young man with neatly side-parted brown hair, a mint short-sleeve shirt, cream high-waisted trousers and suspenders
a smiling middle-aged milkman in a crisp white uniform, white cap and bow tie

lavender.name: Lavender Fairytale
lavender.refs: reference 2008 (flower gowns grown on stems, dandelion trees, lily lake, painter, cloud on an oar)
lavender.style: A romantic pastel fairytale filmed like a dreamy 1970s soft-focus film: lavender, lilac and blush tones, a pale periwinkle sky with big pink-tinted cumulus clouds, lakes full of giant water lilies, oversized dandelion puffs and alliums taller than houses, small mint and pink cottages with white fences far away. Soft diffused light, gentle bloom, light film grain, everything slightly hazy and luminous. Fabrics are real: layered tulle, lace, embroidered silk flowers, sheer veils that move in the breeze.
lavender.music: romantic dreamy waltz, instrumental, music box melody, harp arpeggios, soft legato strings, celesta, gentle 3/4 time, 84 bpm
cast: a young woman with long platinum-blonde curls, a lavender Rococo ball gown covered in tiny embroidered violets and lace ruffles, a wide lilac hat with a sheer trailing veil
a gentle young painter with tousled honey-blond hair and round glasses, a cream beret, a cream jacket over a pale blue waistcoat and trousers
a young woman with strawberry-blonde braids crowned with tiny flowers, a cream lace tea dress with a lilac sash

workshop.name: Dream Workshop
workshop.refs: reference c54a (star shop, cloud candy floss, sunset bubble, moon pancake)
workshop.style: A warm 1970s 35mm cinema film look: cream, honey amber and dusty rose interiors of an old-fashioned workshop, shop or bakery with carved cream cabinetry, glass jars, brass instruments and tall windows; outside, a deep navy starry night or a peach-and-rose sunset sea of clouds. Practical tungsten lamps, soft glow on faces, real film grain, shallow depth of field on hands at work. The magic is crafted by hand with real tools: tweezers, ladles, copper pans, bubble wands, wicker baskets.
workshop.music: whimsical vintage fairytale orchestra, instrumental, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel and celesta melody, warm clarinet, soft waltz, magical workshop, 96 bpm
cast: a freckled teenage girl with a strawberry-blonde bob and a white cotton bonnet, a long cream cotton work coat
a curly-haired young man with dark curls, a cream buttoned work coat
a white-haired old man with round glasses and a white moustache, a cream double-breasted jacket and a small bow tie
a young woman with a neat honey-brown bun, a cream belted coverall

ink.name: Storybook Ink
ink.refs: grid 2 (snowy hillside town in ink and colour), grid 11 (Westminster at dusk in watercolour)
ink.style: A hand-drawn European storybook illustration brought gently to life: clean ink outlines with warm watercolour and gouache washes, ligne-claire detail, steep streets of tall gabled houses in brick red, mustard, rust and cream, windows glowing amber, tiny people in coats and scarves. Paper texture visible. Animated softly and slowly like a living picture book: snow or petals drift, smoke curls from chimneys, tiny figures walk, lamps flicker. The camera barely moves.
ink.music: cosy storybook winter tune, instrumental, music box and celesta melody, pizzicato strings, soft sleigh bells, warm bassoon, 80 bpm
cast: a small girl in a red wool coat and a mustard knitted scarf
an old lamplighter in a long brown coat and a flat cap

nocturne.name: Golden Nocturne
nocturne.refs: grid 6 (snowy Christmas market oil painting), grid 8 (aerial snowy village at night)
nocturne.style: A living classical oil painting: thick visible brushstrokes, deep umber and slate-blue night, warm golden lamplight spilling from shop windows, snow on steep roofs, half-timbered houses, gothic spires, people with black umbrellas walking slowly. Painterly but cinematic, rich chiaroscuro, the glow of candles and lanterns. Animated gently: snow falls, lights twinkle, figures stroll, the camera drifts very slowly.
nocturne.music: nostalgic winter nocturne, instrumental, gentle solo piano melody over soft warm strings, distant celesta, airy choir pad, 66 bpm
cast: a woman in a long dark green wool coat with a red umbrella
a man in a long camel coat and a hat carrying a wrapped parcel

anime.name: Cosy Anime
anime.refs: grid 10 (towering summer cumulus), grid 12 (girl with kettle by the night window)
anime.style: A hand-painted 1990s Japanese animated film: soft painted backgrounds, towering sunlit cumulus clouds in a deep summer blue, lush green hills, cosy wooden kitchens with hanging herbs and glass jars, warm lamp light at night. Clean gentle character drawing, delicate shading, everything calm and nostalgic. Small natural motions: wind in grass, steam, clouds sliding, curtains breathing.
anime.music: nostalgic Japanese animated film score, instrumental, gentle solo piano melody, warm strings, soft wooden flute, summer breeze, 76 bpm

porcelain.name: Porcelain Fantasy
porcelain.refs: grid 4 (giant dreamy girl playing with a miniature lit-up kingdom)
porcelain.style: A soft 3D animated fantasy film: a porcelain-doll-like character with luminous skin, freckles and big dreamy eyes, oversized against miniature worlds - glowing castles, carousels, ferris wheels, canals and lamp-lit bridges - at blue-hour night. Ivory, rose gold and midnight blue with warm fairy-light glints, gentle bokeh, velvety depth of field, tilt-shift miniature feel.
porcelain.music: enchanted lullaby, instrumental, music box melody, harp, celesta, soft strings and airy choir, 70 bpm
